title: Small Freight Forwarder Equity Stake For Sale in Tema, Ghana
tagline: * We are a freight and haulage company based in Tema, Ghana, and have been operating for 2 years. * Last year, the business generated approximately GHS 196,000 in sales, demonstrating potential for further growth. * Sales have declined slightly this year as a key client from last year is no longer under contract. However, 2 new clients are currently in the pipeline, and we project doubling last year's sales by year-end once they come on board. * The business currently operates an asset-light model, relying on third-party transporters, and plans to acquire its own long-haul trucks to improve efficiency and profit margins. * Revenue is generated through freight management, shipping coordination, and haulage fees, with clients billed on a monthly basis. * The business currently has 2 active clients, with 2 additional potential clients in discussions. Client industries include engineering, automotive, and food & agriculture. * The team consists of 4 permanent employees, who are also the directors, keeping operations lean and efficient. * The business is incorporated as a Private Limited Company and is seeking capital to support its growth and expansion.
